note: The seeded demo: one route that runs clean, two that fail in instructive and different ways. Used by the Load demo control on the bench and by tools/screenshots.cjs.

routes.title: A team that gets along
routes.teaches: Two stages, one pot: the kinase parks a phosphate on the sugar and the acyltransferase hangs a fatty chain off that phosphate. Shared window 20–40 °C, pH 7–8.2, nothing eaten, nothing inhibited.

routes.title: A stage handed the wrong molecule
routes.teaches: An isomerase only rearranges the skeleton it knows. Handed glycerol, it stalls and says so, rather than quietly passing the molecule along — which is the failure mode this toy exists to make visible.

routes.title: Both stages work, the pot does not
routes.teaches: Each stage runs perfectly well on its own, and the lane produces a product. The traffic light is still red: invertase wants pH 4–6 and the glucuronosyltransferase wants 6.5–8, so there is no pH either of them could share.

splice.teaches: A pair that clears all six filters at a 6-unit linker — reported as 'Nothing here ruled this out', never as anything stronger. Drag the linker to 2 and the blobs clash; drag it to 20 and the compactness band rejects the dumbbell.
